CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Primary endpoint (OS) was not met statistically, though HR 0.85 suggests numerical trend toward benefit. POPULATION EFFECTS: IC2/3 biomarker-defined subgroup showed better outcomes (11.1 vs 10.6 months OS) but still modest effect size. This suggests the mechanism may work better in PD-L1 high expressors but benefit was limited even in this enriched population. 5. CONFOUNDERS: No clear trial design issues - appropriate comparator, adequate sample size (931 patients), reasonable duration.
